description: Source code for a DPDK Ethernet receiver implementation, including class definitions, methods for starting/stopping reception, and packet processing logic.

classes.name: dummy_frame_notifier
classes.description: A dummy implementation of the frame_notifier interface with an empty on_new_frame method.

methods.name: dpdk_receiver_impl::start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the DPDK Ethernet frame receiver, setting up the receive loop in the executor.

methods.name: dpdk_receiver_impl::stop
methods.description: Requests stopping of the receiver and logs the action.

methods.name: dpdk_receiver_impl::receive_loop
methods.description: Continuously calls receive() in a loop, respecting stop requests and deferring execution.

methods.name: dpdk_receiver_impl::receive
methods.description: Receives a burst of packets from the DPDK port, processes metrics, and notifies about new frames.

methods.name: dpdk_receiver_impl::get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the metrics collector if enabled, otherwise nullptr.
